english.note: This is the everyday colloquial choice for saying that someone is fired.

exampleSentences.english: The company gave me the sack.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 bei2 gaan1 gung1 si1 caau2 jau4 jyu2 laa3

english.note: Use this colloquial phrase for firing or dismissing someone from a job or post.

exampleSentences.english: He’s always late, so the company may remove him from his job.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢成日遲到，間公司可能會炒佢魷魚。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3 gaan1 gung1 si1 ho2 nang4 wui5 caau2 keoi5 jau4 jyu2
